units.source_text: “唔，也许她把这句话当成‘捉雄河童’的意思了。

en.t: Hmm, maybe she took those words to mean catching a male kappa.

units.source_text: 当时，一向和我妈关系紧张的婶婶也来插一脚，吵得越来越凶。

en.t: At the time, my aunt, who had always been on bad terms with my mother, also butted in, and the quarrel grew worse and worse.

units.source_text: 而且我常年喝得不省人事的爹，听到我们在争执，就不辨缘由看人就打。

en.t: On top of that, my father, who was always drinking himself senseless, heard us arguing and started hitting whoever was there without asking why.

units.source_text: 正闹得乱套的时候，我弟弟趁乱偷了妈妈的钱包，跑去看电影什么的了。

en.t: Just when everything had fallen into chaos, my younger brother took advantage of it to steal my mother's wallet and ran off to see a movie or something.
